sources.title: What is FLUX and How to Use It for Image Generation - mindstudio.ai
sources.snippet: What is FLUX? FLUX is an AI image generation model developed by Black Forest Labs, a company founded by the core team behind Stable Diffusion. Released in 2024, FLUX represents a significant advancement in text-to-image generation technology, offering superior image quality, prompt adherence, and creative flexibility compared to earlier models.
